newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - mogas, gas oil steady, fuel up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - mogas, gas oil steady, fuel up.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday.
Gasoline was steady with eurograde barges selling at $188 fob and talked $188-189. Arbitrage potential to the U.S. underpins the market.
Gas oil was also steady with prompt barges around $1 over August futures but ARA demand thin as German buyers bought from local refiners rather than pay up in strong dollars.
High sulphur fuel oil barges ticked up in early trade for very prompt supplies to $88.50 fob ARA but regular material traded steady to slightly weaker.
Low sulphur barges were steady in quiet talk at $94/$96.
Russian high sulphur straight-run was on offer at a steady two means plus $6 for good quality material.
